name: Eric Adams
role: Mayor of New York City (2022-2025); Brooklyn borough president (2014-2021); New York state senator (2006-2013); NYPD captain
summary: Moderate Democrat and former police captain who campaigned and governed on public safety, rejecting 'defund the police' while backing police reform, gun-law changes and more technology in policing. He is pro-union, supports abortion and LGBTQ protections, favors housing construction and business incentives, and in office opposed raising taxes on high earners. He mixes openly religious language with a stated commitment that government and religion stay out of each other.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: He backed a delivery-worker pay floor but vetoed the grocery extension; no stated position on the general minimum wage.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: In 2021 he proposed a temporary surcharge on incomes above $5 million, but in 2024-25 he opposed higher taxes on high earners, saying they were 'hemorrhaging' and that a billion-dollar tax on wealthy New Yorkers 'hurts the economy'. The most recent position governs.

unions-good.rationale: In his own Labor Day op-ed he credits organized labor with workplace protections, calls himself a union member's son and says his administration works to support labor unions.
